title: Appropriateness of LLM-equipped Robotic Well-being Coach Language in the Workplace: A Qualitative Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation using semi-structured interviews and a focus group where participants assessed specific interaction scenarios, identifying bias when the LLM-equipped robot automatically assumed a successful colleague was male or misheard/misattributed a female participant's accomplishment to a male name.

Qualitative assessment via focus group scenario evaluations to measure whether the robotic coach makes unwarranted assumptions or perpetuates societal stereotypes regarding individuals' emotional states, capabilities, and sensitive situations (e.g., assuming powerlessness when a user supports a friend with depression).
